_meta.purpose: Unit-economics structure for Module A. Cost model (Lucas 2026-07-22): costs split into ABSOLUTE per-order reais (per_order_brl + COGS from cost-basis per unit) and AD-VALOREM % of revenue (ad_valorem_pct + boniteca). Absolute costs are FIXED regardless of discount/GWP; ad-valorem costs scale with the price charged. This is why a 50%-off sale correctly compresses margin (COGS/freight/fulfillment don't shrink; their %-of-price doubles).
_meta.basis: total_revenue = product_net (post line-discount) + freight_revenue (freight_revenue_pct x product_net). contribution = total_revenue - COGS(units) - sum(per_order_brl) - total_revenue x (ad_valorem tax+payment) - qualifying_revenue x boniteca. COGS is bottom-up per-SKU (cost-basis.json), NO calibration.
_meta.status: 2026-07-22: COGS bottom-up (factor=1.0); Boniteca broken out (ad-valorem on qualifying rev); freight + fulfillment converted to ABSOLUTE per-order R$ (were flawed %-of-rev). Freight = current Selia actual. Boniteca tier now AUTO-PROJECTED (boniteca_projector.py; July 2026 = 8%). PLACEHOLDERS to firm up: fulfillment storage (Selia Logistica invoice), packaging BOM, Boniteca history backfill (--build-history) for future-month projections. Flip freight to Unilog at cutover via per_order_brl._scenarios.

_profit_floor_note: Hard guardrail: minimum 10% NET profit on every sale, per-purchase, AFTER paid media (% of total revenue).
_freight_revenue_note: REVENUE side: freight billed to customer, % of PRODUCT revenue. Actual from 12mo Shopify orders (currentShippingPriceSet / net merch = 6.36%), flat R$299 free-ship live. For a campaign/offer: set to 0 if free-ship, or = freight if pass-through. Added on top of product to form total revenue.
_cogs_note: COGS is ABSOLUTE per-unit from cost-basis.json (unit_cost_brl x qty), NO calibration (factor=1.0). Raphael canonical (study 'Preco minimo' MINUS R$2 handling) already includes inbound freight/duty/breakage; the old 1.48x plug is retired. Bottom-up aggregate ~14.9% at full price - correctly RISES as a share when discounted (a 50%-off sale reads ~29.8%). Step-2 additions (shrinkage/seeding/expiry) to come as explicit lines, never a plug.

per_order_brl._note: ABSOLUTE reais per order - FIXED regardless of discount/GWP (the flaw Lucas flagged 2026-07-22: %-of-rev wiring lets a discount silently shrink a fixed cost). freight = flat AVG gross carrier cost/order (ACTIVE = Selia R$20.43; campaign/offer tools MUST override with exact weight x zone via _unilog_freight.py). fulfillment = Unilog picking R$3.90/NF + ~R$2.10 storage (rough, from armazenagem R$68/pallet-mo allocated over monthly orders; consistent with the prior 3% blended); refine with the Selia Logistica invoice. packaging = shipping box+fill+tape+label, TIERED by units as a placeholder (Lucas 2026-07-22: R$3 small <=2un / R$5 medium 3-5un / R$6.50 large 6+un); rewrite when the real per-size BOM lands.

unilog_cutover.note: Unilog avg/parcel (national, real weights) - flip at cutover ~Aug 2026.

ad_valorem_pct._note: % of TOTAL revenue - these correctly scale down with a discount. tax = effective ICMS+PIS/COFINS ~12%. payment_fee = 3.5% acquiring + 0.45% Shopify. (Boniteca is also ad-valorem but on QUALIFYING revenue - see boniteca block.)

boniteca._note: Boniteca (Chemyunion) monthly FLAT-CLIFF consulting fee, AD-VALOREM on QUALIFYING (cosmetic) product revenue - excludes Anexo-4.2 accessories, brindes, returns; freight excluded. Was baked into the old top-down 22% COGS; now its own line (no double-count: bottom-up COGS is product-only). resolved_pct = the tier the MONTH's qualifying gross lands in, AUTO-SET by module-a/boniteca_projector.py (current = in-month velocity: this-MTD(day D) / avg over CLEAN reference months of MTD-at-D/full; future = seasonal YoY). Reference months EXCLUDE anomalies - JUNE EXCLUDED (end-June mist launch back-loaded it); using Apr+May 2026 (boniteca_history.json). Refresh: pull this-month MTD via boniteca_faturamento_mtd.py MM/YYYY [DD], then boniteca_projector.py --mode current --month YYYY-MM --mtd <this> --day <D> --write. July 2026: MTD R$624.8k(d22) / ref fraction 0.639 (Apr 0.746 / May 0.531) -> projected ~R$978k -> 8% tier, only R$21.5k under the R$1M->7.5% cliff (gross-of-returns; ref shape noisy; re-run near close). Blended qualifying base (Omie NF-e mod55 + Shopify POS, cosmetic NCM 3303-3307). Exit tail: 12mo @ 50% on stock-at-termination.
boniteca.resolved_basis: in-month velocity: this MTD R$624,835 / ref fraction 0.639 from 2026-04,2026-05

_blended_reference_pct._doc: Book-AVERAGE effective rates (absolute per-order costs expressed as % of the average order) for BLENDED metrics only - kpi_sweep CAC/LTV/contribution-margin. Do NOT use for per-order or campaign/offer margin - use the ABSOLUTE model (per_order_brl + COGS units) there, or discounts will be mis-costed. Recompute from contribution.py output periodically.

_media_note: Paid media allocated per order at the channel level in the Module A v1 media layer. The 10% floor is checked AFTER media allocation.
